name: Informatics Data Center co-location facility, Charlieville
notes: Company page says Informatics commissioned a built-for-purpose co-location data center in June 2015 in central Trinidad; address listed as 1-5 Ramlogan Mangalie Way, Akaloo Street East, Charlieville, Chaguanas. Datacenters.com corroborates the Chaguanas/Charlieville location.

name: iGovTT / Government Tier IV data centre project, Phoenix Park Industrial Estate tender area
developer: Government of Trinidad and Tobago / iGovTT
notes: Guardian reports a Tier 4 government data-centre project began in 2022; 2023 iGovTT tender was for a proposed Tier 4 facility at Phoenix Park Industrial Estate, near Point Lisas, with equipment reportedly acquired and set up, but the final location has not been publicly disclosed.

name: EY Energy to Intelligence 300 MW data centre, Debe special economic zone candidate
developer: Ernst & Young LLP with third-party partners
notes: State media says the government signed an MoU with EY for a 300 MW data centre under the E2I platform. Guardian reports Public Utilities Minister Barry Padarath said the proposed AI data centres are being looked at particularly for a Debe special economic zone; MoUs remain subject to due diligence/further negotiations.

name: Hummingbird AI Holdings 150 MW AI infrastructure and data-centre facility, Debe special economic zone candidate
notes: MoU covers a proposed 150 MW AI infrastructure and data-centre facility, with potential expansion to 500 MW and initial commercial operation targeted for Q1 2028 if the project advances. Guardian identifies Debe special economic zone as the location being considered for the proposed data centres.

name: Amplia DC1
notes: Inflect lists Amplia DC1 as an operational data center/colocation facility at 153 Tragarete Road, Port of Spain, formerly Massy Communications DC1. Datacenters.com corroborates Massy Communications has one Port of Spain data center at the same address.

name: Air Link Communications Princes Town data center
notes: Inflect lists one Princes Town data center: Air Link Communications Princes Town on Saint Croix Road. Data Center Map also lists one facility in Princes Town.

name: Amplia DC2
notes: Inflect and Datacenters.com list Amplia DC2 as a carrier-neutral colocation/data center at 0 Cipero Street, San Fernando, operated by Massy Communications Ltd / Amplia.
